candidate.definition_en: The head of the Roman Catholic Church.
candidate.explanation_ar: رئيس الكنيسة الكاثوليكية، وبيكون مقره في الفاتيكان.

senses.definition_en: The head of the Roman Catholic Church.

examples: The cardinals gathered in Rome to elect a new pope.
Many people gathered in the square hoping to see the pope.
The election of a new pope was announced to the crowd.
candidate.mnemonic: الـ 'Pope' هو 'بابا' الفاتيكان.. الكلمتين شبه بعض جداً.
